# libfdt

These files are the BSD-licensed libfdt sources from the pinned Radxa U-Boot
tree (`39cd993e5d6296635438e84f4576b3a9bf76f86e`), originally maintained by
the Device Tree Compiler project. They are compiled only for chainloader
variants and their host tests. Each source carries the complete dual-license
notice; this project selects the BSD license option.
